test: source-built release core and release ASR worker; external native timer; isolated synthetic paced file

negative_synthetic_model.monitoring_note: Original harness exited before sampling; resumed existing owned driver without re-running it.

harness_issues.failure: Harness expected WAV in the audio directory; product stored it in the meeting files directory.
harness_issues.loss: Sampled positive child list existed only in process memory and was not written before aggregation failed.

harness_issues.failure: Test harness attempted to create a meeting audio directory that the product had already created.
harness_issues.recovery: Verified the owned waiting driver's PID and command line; continued the same attempt with synthetic sentinel files in the existing empty directory, without restarting the driver.
harness_issues.limits: Original process-tree sampler did not survive the setup exception.

limitations: Release source build, not a formal packaged executable or installer.
OS page cache uncontrolled; copying and checking model before test warms page cache. First means first engine receipt, not cold filesystem.
External timer originates before replay; stop request and any delay are reported.
Synthetic FFmpeg replay is not real CPAL microphone or physical product UI stop.
Process sampling data was lost when the harness aggregation failed; later OS inspection found no driver, ASR worker or FFmpeg process, but does not prove that every short-lived child was sampled.
Negative test uses isolated zero-filled files with expected model file sizes; source inspection and rejection before capture support no-spawn, but no complete process trace survived.
Synthetic existing PCM and marker in the negative fixture are unchanged; no new take, capture data or marker was observed.
No user model files, user audio, microphone or GPU used.
